title: SignatureEnvelope
description: Detached signature for a ScanReport. Kept outside the report so that a signed and an unsigned report are byte identical and key rotation does not rewrite the report.
$comment: body_hash = blake3-256(canonical(ScanReport without envelope)). The signature covers the domain separation tag periskop/report-sig/v1 followed by body_hash.

body_hash.description: blake3-256 over the canonical report body. The envelope block is the only field excluded from the scope.

algorithm.description: Extending this enum is a MAJOR change: it splits verifiers.
